Node 05: IP & Patent Route Strategy

Pivot Recommended

Statutory Assessment:

A broad product patent claiming the combination of Ashwagandha and classical ingredients will face absolute rejection under Section 3(p) of the Patents Act, 1970 as a mere aggregation of traditional knowledge.

Recommended Alternative:

Protect the novel standardized extraction process via a Process Patent + Register Trademark for brand assets + Phytopharmaceutical regulatory pathway under 2025 AYUSH Guidelines.

Key Differentiator

Why Not A Broad Patent?

IP-SAKTI explains which route needs review, why, and what alternative path should be investigated.

Why This Route Needs Review

High Review Risk
  • Section 3(p) Exclusions: Indian Patents Act excludes traditional knowledge or aggregation of known properties of plants.
  • TKDL Prior Art Signal: Classical Samhita disclosures (Charaka / Sushruta) cite Ashwagandha adaptogenic use.
  • Lack of Non-Obviousness: Mixing classical plants without synergistic evidence fails inventive step criteria.
"Source Citation: Manual of Patent Office Practice & Procedure, Section 3(p) Guidelines."

What To Investigate Instead

Potential Alternative
  • Process Patent on Extraction: Claim the novel temperature/solvent bio-enhancement process.
  • Phytopharmaceutical Route: File under 2025 AYUSH Phytopharmaceutical drug approval guidelines with clinical data.
  • Trade Secret & Trademark: Proprietary ratio as trade secret + Registered Trademark for brand value.
"Confidence Level: High (Statutory Certainty under AYUSH 2025 Rules)."

Sources & Statutory Evidence

Every conclusion generated by IP-SAKTI is tied directly to published statutory frameworks.

Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL)

Verifiable Source

Joint initiative of CSIR and Ministry of AYUSH containing digitized formulations from Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Yoga.

IP India 2025 AYUSH Examination Guidelines

Statutory Rule

Revised guidelines issued by the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks for evaluating traditional medicine inventions.

Biological Diversity Act, 2002 & 2023 Amendments

Statutory Act

Enacted by Parliament to regulate access to biological resources and fair equity sharing via National Biodiversity Authority (NBA).

WIPO GRATK Treaty (2024)

International Treaty

WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge mandating patent applicant disclosures.
